description: Source code for Kubernetes service account tokens controller, managing creation, update, and deletion of service account token secrets and their references.

classes.name: TokensController
classes.description: Controller managing service account token secrets, handling creation, update, and deletion of tokens and references.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's worker routines and manages lifecycle until context is canceled.

methods.name: queueServiceAccountSync
methods.description: Enqueues a service account for synchronization based on add/update/delete events.

methods.name: queueServiceAccountUpdateSync
methods.description: Enqueues a service account for sync on update.

methods.name: syncServiceAccount
methods.description: Processes a service account key, deletes tokens if the service account no longer exists.

methods.name: queueSecretSync
methods.description: Enqueues a secret for synchronization.

methods.name: queueSecretUpdateSync
methods.description: Enqueues a secret for sync on update.

methods.name: syncSecret
methods.description: Processes a secret, manages token creation, deletion, or updates based on secret state.

methods.name: deleteTokens
methods.description: Deletes all token secrets associated with a service account.

methods.name: deleteToken
methods.description: Deletes a specific token secret, with optional UID precondition.

methods.name: secretUpdateNeeded
methods.description: Determines if a secret needs CA, namespace, or token data updates.

methods.name: generateTokenIfNeeded
methods.description: Populates missing token, CA, or namespace data in a secret if needed.

methods.name: removeSecretReference
methods.description: Removes a secret reference from a service account if present.

methods.name: getServiceAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a service account from cache or live, verifying UID if provided.

methods.name: getSecret
methods.description: Retrieves a secret from cache, verifying UID if provided.

methods.name: listTokenSecrets
methods.description: Lists all token secrets referencing a given service account.

methods.name: getSecretReferences
methods.description: Returns a set of secret names referenced by a service account.

methods.name: makeServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Creates a key object for service account queueing.

methods.name: parseServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Parses a service account queue key.

methods.name: makeSecretQueueKey
methods.description: Creates a key object for secret queueing.

methods.name: parseSecretQueueKey
methods.description: Parses a secret queue key.
